targets.rawSql: SELECT label, count(*) AS players FROM v_segment_current WHERE key = '$segment' AND label ~ '^(${cohort:regex})$' GROUP BY label ORDER BY label

SELECT s.label, round(avg(f.num)::numeric, 1) AS mean, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.num) AS median FROM v_segment_current s JOIN v_fact_current f ON f.user_id = s.user_id AND f.key = '$stat' AND f.dim = '' WHERE s.key = '$segment' AND s.label ~ '^(${cohort:regex})$' GROUP BY s.label ORDER BY s.label

panels.title: Milestone funnel by cohort: share of cohort players (%)

targets.rawSql: WITH cohorts AS (SELECT user_id, label FROM v_segment_current WHERE key = '$segment' AND label ~ '^(${cohort:regex})$'), sizes AS (SELECT label, count(*) AS n FROM cohorts GROUP BY label), ms AS (SELECT DISTINCT key, ordinal FROM milestone_event WHERE kind = 'milestone') SELECT ms.key AS milestone, sz.label, round(100.0 * count(m.user_id) / sz.n, 1) AS pct FROM ms CROSS JOIN sizes sz LEFT JOIN cohorts c ON c.label = sz.label LEFT JOIN milestone_event m ON m.user_id = c.user_id AND m.key = ms.key GROUP BY ms.key, ms.ordinal, sz.label, sz.n ORDER BY ms.ordinal, sz.label

SELECT t AS time, s.label AS metric, count(s.user_id) AS value FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 day') t LEFT JOIN segment_membership s ON s.key = '$segment' AND s.label ~ '^(${cohort:regex})$' AND s.valid_from <= t AND (s.valid_to IS NULL OR s.valid_to > t) GROUP BY t, s.label ORDER BY t

panels.title: Returning players per week by cohort (record changed between syncs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', o.observed_at) AS time, s.label AS metric, count(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS value FROM observation o JOIN v_segment_current s ON s.user_id = o.user_id AND s.key = '$segment' AND s.label ~ '^(${cohort:regex})$' WHERE o.changed AND o.observed_at > (SELECT min(o2.observed_at) FROM observation o2 WHERE o2.user_id = o.user_id) AND $__timeFilter(o.observed_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.*, a.last_changed_at, a.times_changed FROM v_player_current p JOIN v_segment_current s ON s.user_id = p.user_id AND s.key = '$segment' AND s.label ~ '^(${cohort:regex})$' LEFT JOIN v_player_activity a ON a.user_id = p.user_id ORDER BY a.last_changed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500
